_comment: Curated demo questions. 'task_id' entries have code-computed ground truth (graded); 'question' entries are free-form (SQL is run, not graded). Notes reflect recorded eval results (pass rate over 3-4 samples).

examples.title: Residential framing: wholesale price in cents/kWh
DST gotcha: the repeated hour on fall-back day
Battery schedule revenue (HELD-OUT template)
examples.note: never seen in training: SFT 100%, base 0%

examples.title: Wind output during negative prices (cross-table join)
Price at the peak net-load hour (HELD-OUT, honest gap)
examples.note: SFT 0%, Sonnet 100%: what RL should fix

freeform: What was the highest 15-minute real-time price at HB_HOUSTON during January 2024, in $/MWh?
On 2024-08-20, what was the average day-ahead price at HB_WEST, in $/MWh rounded to 2 decimals?
Which trading hub had the most 15-minute real-time intervals with negative prices in April 2025? Answer with the settlement point name.
What share of ERCOT generation came from solar in June 2025, as a percentage rounded to 1 decimal?

What would a 10 MW battery have earned on 2025-08-20 at HB_NORTH by charging during HE11-HE14 and discharging during HE19-HE22 at day-ahead prices, assuming 90% efficiency on discharge? Answer in dollars rounded to 2 decimals.
